 From iPads and noise-canceling AirPods to the latest AirTag and MacBook, these early Amazon Apple deals are worth checking out before Black Friday arrives.
 Kasey Caminiti USA TODAY Nov. 13, 2026 Updated Nov. 14, 2026, 3:01 p.m. ET Hear this story Amazon's best early Black Friday Apple deals worth shopping before Nov. 19
 Amazon is rolling out early Black Friday deals on popular Apple tech ahead of its 12-day holiday sale kicking off on Nov. 19 , making now a good time to shop for savings on some of the brand's most-loved gadgets.
 Whether you're looking for a new tablet, noise-canceling earbuds, a handy tracking device or a laptop upgrade, there are plenty of Apple devices worth adding to your shopping list. And with Apple products often topping holiday wish lists, getting ahead of the seasonal shopping rush could help you check a few gifts off your list early.
 5 best early Black Friday Apple deals at Amazon
 Here, I've highlighted five Apple deals already available at Amazon, including a reliable iPad , best-selling AirPods , multi-functional AirTags , a compact iPad Mini and a powerful MacBook . From practical tech upgrades to gifts that are sure to impress, these are the early Black Friday Apple deals worth checking out.
 Don't miss out! Get weekly deals, trends and product recommendations from USA TODAY Shopping delivered straight to your inbox. 1. Shop the Apple iPad 11-Inch at Amazon for under $400 | Purchased 10,000+ times last month
 Apple iPad 11-Inch, A16 Chip, Liquid Retina Display, 128GB, Wi-Fi 6 Bring entertainment and everyday productivity together with this 11-inch iPad. Its generous display makes streaming, reading, browsing and video calls more enjoyable whether at home or on the go daily. Buy now for less than $400 at Amazon The Apple iPad with A16 chip is a great gift for students, family members or anyone who wants a convenient device for entertainment and staying connected. Whether you're replacing an older tablet or buying your first iPad, this is a classic Apple pick to keep an eye on during Amazon's early Black Friday sale.
 More: I test trending tech for a living. These 9 are actually worth gifting 2. Save 20% on Apple AirPods Pro 3 before Amazon's Black Friday sale
 Apple AirPods Pro 3 Wireless Earbuds with Active Noise Cancellation Enjoy immersive listening with Apple's AirPods Pro 3. Active noise cancellation helps create a more focused experience for commuting, traveling, working or unwinding with favorite music and podcasts throughout the day. Save 20% at Amazon For the person who always has headphones within reach, Apple AirPods Pro 3 make a particularly appealing holiday gift. Designed with active noise cancellation, they offer a more immersive listening experience for commuting, traveling, working or simply enjoying some quiet time.
 More: How these open-ear headphones turn sound into something you can feel 3. Save 29% on the Apple AirTag 2nd Generation at Amazon | Purchased 10,000+ times in the last month
 Apple AirTag 2nd Generation, 4-Pack Keep track of everyday essentials with Apple's second-generation AirTag. Pair it with the Find My network to help locate keys, bags and luggage when they go missing from your routine. Save 29% at Amazon Attach one AirTag tracker to a set of keys, slip it into a bag or keep track of luggage with Apple's Find My ecosystem. The second-generation model also brings improvements to Precision Finding and speaker volume, making it an especially useful accessory for keeping tabs on belongings.
 More: Apple’s 2nd-gen AirTags are under $18 each in this 4-pack deal 4. Shop the Apple iPad Mini with A17 Pro on sale at Amazon | Rarely goes on sale
 Apple iPad Mini with A17 Pro Enjoy tablet convenience in a more portable size with the iPad mini. Its A17 Pro chip and compact design make it handy for reading, gaming, streaming and everyday tasks anywhere. Buy now for less than $570 The Apple iPad Mini combines a compact design with the performance of an A17 Pro chip, making it a convenient option for reading, streaming, gaming and staying productive on the go.
 Its smaller footprint makes it especially appealing for travelers, commuters and anyone who wants more screen space than a smartphone without carrying a full-size tablet.
 More: 8 genius travel gifts under $50, according to a digital nomad 5. Save nearly $200 on the 2026 Apple MacBook 13-Inch | Amazon's Choice, more than 5,000 sold in the last month
 Apple 2026 MacBook 13-Inch Laptop with M5 chip Take your work and entertainment anywhere with Apple's 13-inch MacBook. Its portable laptop format makes it a practical pick for students, professionals and anyone upgrading their everyday computing setup needs. Save $199.01 at Amazon For a bigger-ticket holiday gift, consider the Apple 2026 MacBook 13-inch . A laptop is an especially useful upgrade for students, professionals and anyone who needs a reliable computer for everyday tasks. Apple laptops don't always see substantial discounts, so early Black Friday markdowns are worth watching.
 More: The best tech products of 2026, according to USA TODAY What time does Amazon Black Friday start?
 Amazon's Black Friday sale starts on Thursday, Nov. 19 at 12:00am PT/3:00am ET .
 More: Prime members get $0 Uber Eats delivery, plus $20 off first two orders Should you shop these Apple deals now or wait until Black Friday?
 The answer depends on the price you're seeing and how soon you need the product. If an Apple device you've been eyeing is already discounted to a price that fits your budget, shopping early could help you avoid last-minute holiday shopping stress.
 On the other hand, shoppers who aren't in a hurry may want to monitor prices as Amazon's official event gets underway. Just remember that discounts, availability and eligible configurations can change throughout the sale.
 Either way, these early Apple deals are a good starting point for anyone looking to upgrade their tech or get a head start on holiday gifting.
